name: dsh-gittree
description: GitTree: a READ-ONLY git tab type for the dsh-vn-plugins right bar (dsh-rightbar). Lists the session workspace's git tree with a status badge per file, opens any file through the ordinary file address (so the editor or a shipped preview claims it), and shows the commit history with a commit's changed files. A page type like the editor: one guide entry on the tab strip's + / Start page, no core patches, nothing forked, and no git command that can write. Alpha.
